But that doesn't mean everyone has to agree with me. And it certainly doesn't mean I'm right about everything. (Although I do occasionally have to remind Hal of that.) We hear constantly from people telling us why we SHOULD use AI. I want to hear from the people who aren't. Have you tried it and decided it wasn't for you? Do you have concerns about accuracy, privacy, ethics, or something else? Maybe you simply don't see a need for it. I'm not looking to change your mind, challenge your reasoning or give you a demonstration of everything you're missing. I'm looking to understand something I might be missing. If you're willing to share your perspective, please comment here or send me a private message. I'd love to ask you a few questions. This isn't a gotcha. It's genuine curiosity. And if you prefer not to have your name used in the article, that's absolutely fine. Thanks for helping me see this from another perspective. Please reach out and I'll ask you my questions.
